answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 3394 Country: India Title: My question is 1.one day i offered fajr namaz after that i recited surah yaseen and went to sleep.in that i had a dream that iam at a grave of prophet muhammad sallallahu alaihi wasallam and anybody told that india's prime minister(am forgeting his name) is coming.i got angry that he is a kafir how can he come iam shouting no no..then i put my hand in that grave i found a paper is in my hand in which i saw a photo with a beard anybody is telling that is urs photo(bade hone ke baad ki photo hai).that time i dont have any beard.what is the meaning of this. Question: My question is 1.one day i offered fajr namaz after that i recited surah yaseen and went to sleep.in that i had a dream that iam at a grave of prophet muhammad sallallahu alaihi wasallam and anybody told that india's prime minister(am forgeting his name) is coming.i got angry that he is a kafir how can he come iam shouting no no..then i put my hand in that grave i found a paper is in my hand in which i saw a photo with a beard anybody is telling that is urs photo(bade hone ke baad ki photo hai).that time i dont have any beard.what is the meaning of this. Answer ID: 3394 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 420/B=45/TB) Ma-sha-Allah, your dream is blessed one. It is hoped that your shall very much adhere sunnah in-sha-Allah. The same meaning is also applied to your dream of beard. As far as stopping prime minister is concerned it indicates that you shall succeed to protect yourself from influences of kuffar. May Allah enable you to perform good deeds! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
